name: Lamara Heartwell
reason: No website of her own could be found: two web searches (4 Nov 2026) turned up only her Esalen faculty bio (no current programme, no link to a site of her own), podcast and dance-listing pages, and old event listings; with no own site there is no published email or contact form, base page or offerings to list. Her Esalen bio says she founded Santa Barbara Dance Tribe, but no site for it surfaced and URLs were not guessed.
